verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own docs say it posts comments directly on PRs and MRs (shown for Secrets findings), that its GitHub integration automates PR comments, and that CI scans run on pull and merge request events. The core story is delivered by the product itself, though the evidence is thin and scattered. Missing for 10: a dedicated PR/MR-comment setup doc covering all products (Code, Supply Chain), explicit naming of GitLab, evidence of status checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab

citations.quote: informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly
You can use Semgrep and its GitHub integration to automate PR comments that you frequently make in code reviews.
your development cycle benefits from the automated scanning of repositories at various events, such as: Push events; Pull requests or merge requests
